feedback.details: Sprint counting regex uses ^## with multiline flag. Tests in phase-1-5-integration.test.ts cover inline prose, blockquotes, acceptance criteria, and indented headings. All tests pass. Spec with 2 line-start headings + inline references correctly yields 2.

Resume path in harness.ts loads existing progress, reads spec from disk, skips completed sprints via startSprint = completedSprints + 1. loadExistingContract reuses contracts from disk. New timestamped log files created via createConversationLog. revertToCheckpoint uses git reset --hard with stash/unstash. Tests cover contract reuse, distinct timestamps on resume. 3 git-ops tests fail in full suite but pass in isolation (test isolation issue, likely HOME=/dev/null env leaking).

commitAdhdMetadata in git-ops.ts creates [adhd] commits with contracts/feedback/progress/spec. --commit-adhd-logs additionally stages .adhd/logs/. Config resolution has commitAdhd: cli.commitAdhd || cli.commitAdhdLogs (implication). Default is false. Tests verify parsing, resolution, commit message format, includeLogs, and no-op behavior.

notify() in notifications.ts always emits \x07 to stdout. With notify: true, it dispatches desktop notification via notify-send (Linux) or osascript (macOS). All HITL gates call notify() before prompting: spec approval, contract preview, dirty tree, evaluator override, mid-run steering. Fatal error in index.ts calls notify(). Tests verify bell emission and flag parsing.

HarnessProgress status union includes 'documenting'. In harness.ts runSprintLoop, status transitions: planning → spec-review → negotiating → building → evaluating → (loop) → documenting → complete. 'documenting' set at line 550 before runDocumenterPhase. 'complete' set at line 564. Tests verify all transitions and that 'documenting' appears between evaluating and complete.

parseContract in contract.ts writes diagnostic file via writeParseErrorDiagnostic on failure. Directory created with mkdir recursive. Truncated preview (500 char cap) logged to console. Successful parses produce no diagnostic. Tests verify diagnostic file creation, content preservation for long input, and no diagnostic on success.

All conversation logs use fileTimestamp() for YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS prefix. Tests verify generator, evaluator, contract-negotiation, and documenter logs all have timestamp prefix. Multiple runs produce distinct files with chronological ordering verified.

commitAdhdArtifacts called at sprint-attempts.ts line 42 immediately before generator invocation. Stages and commits all .adhd/ files with [adhd] prefix. Tests verify clean working tree after commit. However, 2 git-ops tests fail in full suite (pass in isolation) suggesting fragile test environment.

CRITICAL FAILURE: README.md does NOT contain --notify, --commit-adhd, or --commit-adhd-logs. grep confirms zero matches for these strings. The Configuration table is missing all three flags. While --resume is documented, the three new Sprint 4/5 flags are completely absent from the README. CLI_FLAG_HELP has them, and --help output shows them, but the README criterion explicitly requires README documentation. Tests for this criterion fail: 'expect(readme).toContain("--notify")' fails.

Nearly all catch blocks have comments, log calls, re-throws, or returns. A few catch blocks with just comments (e.g., '// Documenter failure is non-fatal' at harness.ts:219, '// skip unreadable installed dir' in skills.ts) are borderline but defensible. The harness.ts:219 catch is redundant since runDocumenterPhase already has its own try/catch with logging. No truly empty catch blocks found. git-ops.ts:132 has a catch that does 'Best effort — continue regardless' which is reasonable.

Functions consistently use camelCase (commitAdhdArtifacts, fileTimestamp, loadExistingContract). Types/interfaces use PascalCase (HarnessProgress, SprintContract, AgentRunners). Constants use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (CLI_FLAG_HELP, CLAUDE_MODEL, PARSE_ERROR_PREVIEW_LENGTH). File names use kebab-case throughout shared/ and harness-claude/. No abbreviations without precedent.

fileTimestamp is the single timestamp utility. notify() is the single notification dispatch. commitAdhdArtifacts and commitAdhdMetadata share git-ops module. loadExistingContract used by both --resume and --sprint paths. Some git command repetition (git rev-parse HEAD in multiple files) is contextually appropriate rather than copy-paste.

Zero @anthropic-ai imports in shared/. All SDK-specific code is in harness-claude/. AgentRunners interface in shared/orchestration/types.ts is the only bridge. Verified via grep: no SDK imports in any shared/ TypeScript file.

Static analysis confirms: 'Checked 38 files in 25ms. No fixes applied.' with exit code 0. TypeScript has 5 errors all in test files (conversation-logger.test.ts and tracing.test.ts) — the tracing.test.ts error is missing notify/commitAdhd/commitAdhdLogs on mock config, which is a legitimate type error but only in tests.

notify() emits \x07 and is called before all HITL gates: spec approval (gates.ts:50), contract preview (harness.ts:464), dirty tree (git-ops.ts:188), evaluator override (sprint-attempts.ts:208), mid-run steering (sprint-success.ts:84).

git-ops.ts commitAdhdMetadata: when includeLogs is true, pushes '.adhd/logs/' to pathsToStage. Tests verify logs are committed.
config.ts line 348: commitAdhd: cli.commitAdhd || cli.commitAdhdLogs || false. Tests verify --commit-adhd-logs alone sets both to true.
config.ts defaults both to false. commitAdhdMetadata only called when config.commitAdhd is true (sprint-success.ts:48). Tests verify default config has both false.
CLI entry point starts cleanly with --help, showing all new flags. parseCli correctly parses --notify, --commit-adhd, --commit-adhd-logs. No runtime errors on startup.

overallSummary: The codebase is well-structured with solid implementation of Phase 1.5 features: sprint counting, timestamp logging, resume/contract reuse, notifications, commit-adhd flags, and SDK separation are all properly implemented. However, the sprint FAILS due to one critical gap: the README.md is missing documentation for --notify, --commit-adhd, and --commit-adhd-logs flags (score 3/10, well below threshold 7). These flags are in CLI_FLAG_HELP and --help output, but the contract requires 'README or equivalent documentation describes --resume, --notify, --commit-adhd, and --commit-adhd-logs flags with usage examples and explains their interaction'. Additionally, 5 tests fail: 2 README tests (legitimate failures) and 3 git-ops tests that pass in isolation but fail in the full suite (likely test environment contamination from HOME=/dev/null). TypeScript has 5 errors in test files only (not source). Biome lint is clean.
